desc: The standing House Oversight and Government Reform panel that carries the UAP file in the 119th Congress. Chaired by Rep. Anna Paulina Luna (FL-13) with Rep. Jasmine Crockett (TX-30) as ranking member, its Republican membership is Nancy Mace (SC-01), Tim Burchett (TN-02), Lauren Boebert (CO-04), Eric Burlison (MO-07), Eli Crane (AZ-02) and Brandon Gill (TX-26), and its Democratic membership Raja Krishnamoorthi (IL-08), Summer Lee (PA-12), Dave Min (CA-47), Stephen Lynch (MA-08) and Maxwell Frost (FL-10). The roster is the point: Mace chaired the November 2024 UAP hearing, Burchett and Luna convened the July 2023 Grusch hearing, and Burlison employs David Grusch as a Special Advisor. The task force is not a UAP body - its declared remit spans the JFK, RFK and MLK assassination files, Epstein records, MKULTRA and UAP - and that breadth is exactly what allows it to treat UAP as a declassification problem rather than an aerospace one. It held 'Restoring Public Trust Through UAP Transparency and Whistleblower Protection' on 9 September 2025 in HVC-210, and on 30 June 2026 held 'Mind Control and Accountability: Uncovering the Truth of the CIA's MKULTRA Project.' Its instrument of choice in 2026 has been the document demand rather than the hearing: Luna's April 2026 letter that Release 02 was said to answer, and Burlison's 22 May 2026 ten-page, forty-plus-request production demand to MITRE.
